a change becomes at most one alert
AFTER INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE on products:
• an UPDATE that changes nothing is skipped (<=>)
Runs inside MySQL — catches edits from any tool.
Why the links are logical (no FOREIGN KEY)
Chosen on purpose — history must outlive the data:
• a deleted product's change history is kept
• a purged alert's broadcast log is kept (audit trail)
Consistency comes from the trigger and one JDBC
PK = primary key → = refers to another table dashed line = logical link (no FK constraint)
